fields.name: User
fields.evidence: macOS default constructor stores its first argument (str w1, [x23]) at +0; PointAndClickSoundSystem keeps a HashMap<net::UserID, PointAndClickSoundStateComponent*> (macOS) and ResetPlayerState (EoCClient.dll+0xDFEFF0) finds the state by user id. Live: always 1 (the local user).

fields.name: _Pad4
fields.evidence: Alignment before the 8-byte handle; live bytes vary (0, 0xFFFFFFF4, ...) - uninitialised padding.

fields.name: Target
fields.evidence: ResetPlayerState writes the global DAT_1819cb010 (null handle) to +8; macOS default stores x3 (str x3, [x23, #8]). Live: 0xFFC0000000000000 (null entity handle). Probably the entity the point-and-click sound refers to - name is a guess.

fields.name: Actions
fields.evidence: ResetPlayerState clears a hash set at +0x10: memsets the bucket table (+0x10 pointer, +0x18 count) to 0xFF, walks IndexedStorage<enum ecl::sound::EPointAndClickActionType> keys (capacity +0x38, size +0x3C) and resets the next-id array at +0x20. Element width of the enum not established (values up to 0x11 seen in ChangeActionIfNeeded) - declared uint8_t. Live: empty.

fields.name: field_40
fields.evidence: macOS default: strb wzr, [x23, #0x40]. Live: 0 (the following 3 bytes vary - padding).

fields.name: Count
fields.evidence: ResetPlayerState zeroes 8 bytes at +0x4C; PointAndClickSoundSystem::ChangeActionIfNeeded (EoCClient.dll+0xDFC500) compares a helper's result with *(int*)(state+0x4C) + 1 (a play counter). Name is ours.

fields.name: Cooldown
fields.evidence: ChangeActionIfNeeded advances the action only when *(float*)(state+0x50) <= 0.0 (a timer); reset to 0 by ResetPlayerState. Name is ours.
